Looking for a truly luxurious Great Escape? Is it a special birthday or anniversary? The Auriga spa set inside The Setai Fifth Avenue, a new luxe hotel that opened in November 2010 in mid-town, is just the place to treat yourself to pure pampering bliss. Taking over the entire fourth floor of the hotel, at 11,500 square feet, this is not your typical urban spa. Designed to be “a tranquil retreat of nourishment that realigns the chaotic rhythm of New York City”, the spa does that with all thoughts of stress evaporating once you step inside.

Spa treatments here are deigned to “engage body, mind, and spirit in a natural and holistic restorative process.” The spa has 11 private treatment rooms, and after your treatment of choice—including body treatments and facials, it’s time to experience the indulgent amenities of the spa. The co-ed area is designed for couples to enjoy it together, whether they step inside the sauna, steam room, plunge pools, hammam or experiential showers. The male and female separate locker rooms offer a full array of products to ready you for the night or you can add on beauty services at the Julien Farel Salon for both men and women, including hair styling, make-up application, nail care and even classic shaves for men. You will both be ready for a night on the town following your rejuvenation.

Auriga spa is located at The Setai Fifth Avenue, 400 Fifth Avenue (between 36th and 37th Streets), New York City.

American Destinations: Sleek Sophistication at Langham Place New York – The Anti Bridezilla

When you live in New York, it’s easy to forget that this bustling metropolis is in fact a major destination for domestic and international travelers around the year. And more importantly, New York is a romantic backdrop that’s perfect for weddings and honeymoons. So, when the preeminent Langham Place reached out and gently reminded me how fantastic my own city can be for a destination wedding, I felt compelled to feature them in my American Destinations series.

The Langham Place is a prominent hotel brand with luxury locations around the world. And in New York, they have a prime location in the heart of Midtown on Fifth Avenue. This five star hotel offers a full suite of wedding planning assistance ranging from customized menus, hand-written place cards, floral arrangements and entertainment. The Manhattan hotel can accommodate weddings as intimate as 36 guests to as large as 650.

Langham Place Fifth Avenue offers a wide array of diversions to help sooth frazzled wedding planning nerves and give guests a respite from the non-stop action New York offers. Relax at the Langham Spa (which I have personally has the pleasure of using and can promise you is amazing) by indulging in one of their many spa treatment offerings or hydrotherapy in their Aqua Lounge. After a treatment relax in their steam and sauna rooms. Or sneak in a workout at their fully equipped fitness center. Or, a bride and her bridesmaids can opt for a pampering session at the Julien Farel Salon with mani-pedis.

And for guests, they can rest assured that every room offers a gorgeous view. Whether your room overlooks bustling Fifth Avenue, the Empire State Building, or a courtyard view, guests can absorb the Manhattan skyline from the minute they wake up until it’s time for bed. With 157 guest rooms and 57 suites there is truly a room category for every type of guest.

For more information about Langham Place Fifth Avenue and how to secure your own metropolitan wedding here, visit www.langhamhotels.com!
